test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 5 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘REASON’ is written as ‘VODPEJ’ and ‘ORIGIN’ is written as ‘SILDRJ’. How will ‘MEDIUM’ be written in that language?
solution:
The position of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

The logic followed here is:

REASON is written as VODPEJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d39c7d4311bcc2537d93ae4d759b89ff0e4d701706fe586bff1cc58232c0e84.png] 

ORIGIN is written as SILDRJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e0c4c8e4d28ac21905143b3e1d50af3db14750ffd136d2d3a0f235d397b38c9.png] 

Similarly, MEDIUM is written as QUGFEI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32e7d5a8cd511f86459f314fcc3a107a08d20aff63eca06c9fc2e30dc0e562a1.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is __**QUGFEI**__.
